Name: Passable Ladders
Author: jhalslk
Description:
This mod allows a player to walk over ladders within the mines. Inspiration/base for this mod came from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/824]RopeBridge[/url], but that sadly wasn't working for 1.3. I've updated it accordingly while refactoring it a bit. This currently dosen't support the shafts that are within the Skull Cavern mines, but I will look into adding that in a future release.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Provide a few sentences explaining how to use your mod. For example, the default buttons to press, where to find a menu, etc. You can remove this section if it's self-evident.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.3 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player. Will need to test multiplayer. Not sure how mines work in multiplayer since I've never played multiplayer.
[/list]
